steps.en: Install the plugin from your host's marketplace
steps.zh: 在宿主的插件市场装好插件

steps.en: Brainstorm a rough idea before any code
steps.zh: 写码前先头脑风暴一个粗糙想法

steps.en: Runs interactive Q&A and writes a requirements-only plan
steps.zh: 连环追问澄清需求，写出 requirements-only 计划

steps.en: Grow the plan, then execute it
Enriches the plan with your past learnings, implements it, keeping host verification and commits
steps.zh: 带着过往经验细化计划并实现，保留宿主验证与 commit

steps.en: Multi-agent review against the plan — report-only, applying fixes stays your call
steps.zh: 对照计划做多 agent 审查——只出报告，是否应用由你定

steps.en: Close the loop and capture the learning
steps.zh: 收尾循环，把经验沉淀下来

steps.en: Writes the learning to docs/solutions/, which the next brainstorm and plan read as grounding
steps.zh: 把经验写进 docs/solutions/，供下一轮 plan 先读

value.en: Each loop starts from your accumulated decisions instead of a blank slate — run one teaches it, run two remembers
value.zh: 每一轮循环从累积的决策出发，而不是一张白纸——第一次跑教会它，第二次跑它记住了
